inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "The hunters' grounds, the ash and obsidian land where the Sovereign's hunters keep the trophies of every beast and every army they have caught. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. A section of one wide connected region panorama, refined with crisp pixel clusters.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn battle stage with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth", "lighting": "Soft violet dusk light from the upper left, deep blue shadows, violet glow from the obsidian veins, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the ash floor in calm even light, bright and readable.", "color_palette": ["#7a6aa8", "#b8a8d8", "#e8dcf0", "#3a3448", "#1e1a26", "#8a4ad0", "#c08af0", "#9a9a9e", "#c8c6c4", "#5a5660", "#e8e0d0", "#8a5a3a", "#d8b45a", "#a8a6b0", "#8a8896"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "A section of a continuous 2.5D battle stage panorama seen from a fixed side oblique camera, no people: sky above a distant horizon, scenery behind the arena in overlapping rows, a calm empty floor.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 300, 1000], "desc": "a pale lavender dusk sky with long violet clouds"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [540, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "one calm, empty floor of flat pale grey ash and stone running the whole width, a worn trail along its back edge through all three places"}]}}
